report_topic: Performance Audit of Mining of minor minerals with emphasis on illegal mining operations
observations_summary: The existing control measures to curb illegal mining were not complied, leading to short levy of penalty of ₹ 10.51 crore and loss of royalty of ₹ 2.67 crore. DMFTs delayed identifying affected areas and persons, and had an average fund utilization of 63% with ₹ 219.31 crore blocked in incomplete works.
